scope: default-off LD_PRELOAD observer; no vendor/controller/scene modification, training, WBT, Git, cloud, or hardware

capture_contract.activation: only when X2_MJ_SHIM_OUTPUT is nonempty; otherwise hooks pass through without mmap or copy
capture_contract.format: fixed-width mmap, per-row release commit, process-exit msync
capture_contract.threading: atomic record reservation; records sorted by sequence; per-row commit checked
capture_contract.closed_container_plan: mount shim read-only and pass LD_PRELOAD plus X2_MJ_SHIM_* through docker -e; unique ROS_DOMAIN_ID; port 51822 preflight; no real device

validation_order: toy exact-vendor MuJoCo hook off/on, identical deterministic controls
unchanged official scene exact-vendor MuJoCo hook off/on, identical initial state and open-loop controls
only if both pass: one isolated closed AimDK capture, no retry

no_perturbation_gate.primary: all per-step qpos and qvel differences hook on vs off <= 1e-12 in toy and official scene
no_perturbation_gate.trace_integrity: version=3.3.7, contiguous committed rows, no drops, expected step calls and dimensions
no_perturbation_gate.performance: hook wall time <= max(2x control, control+0.1s)

closed_capture_boundary: observes exact vendor MuJoCo calls inside closed simulator, but does not observe ROS queues before the simulator or prove complete wrapper causality
